name: Chiyomi-chan for Me ~Kateikyoushi Seikyouiku Hen~
original_name: ちよみちゃん for Me ～家庭教師 性教育編～
source:
What a lucky guy, he has a beautiful girl to help him study for his exams. She even accepts him when he ask her to be his girlfriend. From then on, it's study and fun times. He will be happy, if he doesn't get distracted by his classmate or the ghost of his first love.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
真是幸运的家伙，有漂亮女孩帮他准备考试。她甚至在他请求后同意成为女朋友。从那以后，他的生活充满学习与快乐时光。

只要不被同学或初恋幽灵分心，他就会很幸福。

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
